title: pitch fader
system_instruction_addendum: PITCH FADER ADDENDUM: The pitch fader is a percentage adjustment to the BPM. Reference the tempo display on the user's deck. Sync is a separate lesson.

tutor_speak.text: the pitch fader is the tall vertical slider on deck A: it nudges the BPM up or down as a percentage.
shift it about a quarter of the throw: watch the tempo display change.

hints.text: the pitch fader is the long slider on the outer edge of deck A.
push it about a quarter of the way down, then back up.
move the pitch fader on deck A a noticeable amount in either direction.
